principles: Serialize scarce workspace validation capacity at every official validation mode while preserving story-scoped evidence isolation.
Make contention observable and self-resolving through asynchronous wait, bounded holder progress, and automatic continuation.
Use one git-common-dir capacity path and a fixed workspace-to-story acquisition order.
Keep proof budgets and command inventories unchanged; remove contention instead of weakening gates.
Fail closed on unknown capacity ownership and reclaim only mechanically proven dead or identity-mismatched holders.
drivers: Different-story, no-story, and --channel/--concept/--lint early-return modes bypass a per-story lock key.
The legacy story classifier permits age-only ownerless reclaim, which is too permissive for a workspace-global capacity lease.
Routine and DONE-required validation must retain distinct evidence artifacts, freshness rules, and configured timeout budgets.

options.name: A: Replace the story lock with one global fail-fast lock
B: Re-key the current story lock globally and keep its age-based classifier
pros: Reuses existing lock path and smoke
cons: Unknown aged ownership can be stolen
Does not provide safe async waiting

options.name: C: Add an outer async workspace lease with strict liveness classification and retain the legacy inner story lock
pros: Covers every validate mode and DONE-required
Supports progress, abort, and automatic continuation
cons: Requires capacity-specific classifier and focused cross-process smoke

options.name: D: Also coordinate direct npm test through inherited tokens

chosen: C: Add an outer async workspace lease with strict liveness classification and retain the legacy inner story lock
rationale: Option C fixes the real capacity race for all official validate modes, including no-story and early selective paths, while retaining the existing per-story evidence lock unchanged. A stricter capacity classifier prevents age-only takeover of unknown ownership; asynchronous acquisition keeps heartbeats and cancellation live without changing proof budgets.

preMortem.trigger: Wrapper remains only around the three existing story-aware branches
preMortem.consequence: --lint or another early-return mode competes with TEST
preMortem.mitigation: Place the capacity boundary around the complete validate handler execution and add real CLI selective-mode smoke.
Use a capacity-specific classifier that treats unknown as active/blocked and only returns stale for provable dead or identity mismatch.
Use fail-fast probes plus abortable awaited timers; prove heartbeat advances while waiting.

preMortem.trigger: Capacity ownership is not AsyncLocal propagated
preMortem.consequence: Official nested operation waits on itself
preMortem.mitigation: Track capacity lock key in AsyncLocal context and prove nested-owner versus sibling behavior.

preMortem.consequence: PASS no longer means documented gates
preMortem.mitigation: Do not edit inventory or budget sources; assert clean diff and timeout identity.
State official-only scope in both command help and docs and mechanically prove direct npm bypass.
